business_summary: Deepak Fertilisers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited engages in the manufacture, trade, and sale of bulk chemicals in India. It operates through the Chemicals, Fertilisers, and Realty segments. The company offers chemicals, including ammonia, methanol, dilute and concentrated nitric acid, carbon dioxide, iso-propyl alcohol, propane, and bulk and speciality chemicals; and fertilisers, such as nitro phosphate, mutriate of potash, diammonium phosphate ap, ammonium sulphate, mixtures, single super phosphate, sulphur, micronutrients, SSF, and bio fertilisers. It also provides pharmacopeia solvents under the PUROSOLV name; food-grade liquid carbon dioxide and solar-grade nitric acid; stainless-steel pickling solutions under the PICKBRITE name; hygiene and disinfectant chemicals under the Cororid and PuroGuard+ names; technical ammonium nitrate products, such as low-density porous prill, high-density uncoated prill, and medical-grade uncoated prill ammonium nitrate products, as well as ammonium nitrate solutions; and NPK, specialty, and water-soluble fertilizers under the Mahadhan brand. In addition, the company provides petroleum; consultancy to mining companies; and value-added blasting services to mining and explosives industries. Further, it engages in the value-added real estate and agriculture produce businesses; storage and handling of technical ammonium nitrate; purchase and sale of commodities; gas trading; brand management; online sale of products; leasing of furniture and home improvement products; development of an e-commerce platform; and construction and operations of design centers, shopping malls, complexes, and retail outlets, as well as other allied activities. Deepak Fertilisers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Pune, India.
